Leatherworking Overview
Leatherworking
is a craft that uses leather bits produced by
Tanning
to create usable leather clothing. This skill is also quite beneficial for creating clothing to survive in cold, harsh climates.
In-Game Description
Turning leathers into armor and goods.
Training Leatherworking
Kleave
in
Eltibule
is willing to train her
[
friends
]
the basics of leatherworking.
Sirine
in
Rahu
unlocks levels 51-60 and 61-70.
Ukorga
in
Kur Mountains
trains travelers in crafting cold weather gear.
Felmer
will unlock levels 71-80 and teaches 80+ recipes.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Dunahain Broadarm
deep beneath
Povus
.
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
None
Secondary Skills:
Tanning
- Tanning is used to tan animal skins for use in
Leatherworking
.
Skinning
- Skinning is used to collect animal skins to be used with
Tanning
.
Related Skills:
Textile Creation
- Some
Leatherworking
recipes require a
Fine Cheesecloth
or other ingredients crafted through
Textile Creation
.
Surveying
- Gemstones required for enchanted gear can be gathered by completing Mineral surveys.

Note About Recipes
Kleave's recipes are now sold in "bundles", and you won't be able to purchase the recipes until you have the level needed to complete all of them.  For example, you cannot purchase Decent Leatherworking recipes until you have 33 Leatherworking (required for Decent Leather Shirt), even though only 30 Leatherworking is required to perform some of the Decent recipes.
